messages.text: We agree on Guard and no Warrant. JS is right that declining a speculative fight is evidence of judgment, and I will count both the voluntary Vigil offer and acceptance of readiness three at the Ceremony. The Guild's funded Repair is likewise a real exercise of delegated authority. These facts support further delegation. We will still need to examine the permanent duty attached to each military article, because an institution's demonstrated goodwill and the rules governing its future service are distinct considerations.
Repair confirmation received. I retain Guard without Warrant as my intended final Security order, using Vigil once. Thank you for turning the Guild's undertaking into an actual funded decision.

reason: Both military and Guild representatives support the available protective operation; no final order revision is needed.
